svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="garuda-dead" name="Deadman Monitor"> <mxGraphModel dx="1222" dy="797" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="740" pageHeight="380" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="t" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=center;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;" value="Deadman Monitor — Garuda_web.py : _deadman_monitor, _send_tamper_email" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="22" width="620" x="60" y="8" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="hb" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" value="Heartbeat Receiver
(POST /api/heartbeat)
client pings to reset timer
updates _last_heartbeat" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="185" x="30" y="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="dm" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" value="Deadman Thread
(_deadman_monitor)
daemon, checks every 10s
180s timeout window" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="185" x="265" y="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="hb" style="rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;" target="dm"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="timeout" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" value="Timeout Evaluator
(now − _last_heartbeat
> 180s → tamper event)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="185" x="510" y="55" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e2" edge="1" parent="1" source="dm" style="rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;" target="timeout"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tamper" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" value="Tamper Email<br>(_send_tamper_email)<br>SMTP to admin address<br>includes timestamp + context" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="75" width="185" x="510" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e3" edge="1" parent="1" source="timeout" style="rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;" target="tamper"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="alt" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontStyle=1;fontSize=11;" value="Alert Trigger
(trigger_software_alert)
fires visual + WS alert
on tamper event" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="75" width="185" x="265" y="240" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e4" edge="1" parent="1" source="timeout" style="rounded=0;orthogonalLoop=1;edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;" target="alt"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"> <Array as="points"> <mxPoint x="530" y="170" /> <mxPoint x="358" y="170" /> </Array> </mxGeometry> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
